==Acquisition==
Rare drop from [[Zealot's Chest]] in [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]].

==Summons==
Using this item will summon the following two allies:

*{{w}} [[Ghost of Bock]]
*{{r}} [[Vell (summon)|Vell]]

These allies will be 5 levels lower than the player, with a minimum level of 5, and a maximum level of 15.

==Notes==
* This is one of only three summoning stones that are reusable by level 20 characters (the others being the unique variant of the [[Ascalonian War Horn (unique)|Ascalonian War Horn]], and the [[Legionnaire Summoning Crystal]]).
* This item is not tradeable, but it can be shared between characters on the same account.
